posts.meta_description:
693K likes, 3,609 comments - lewishamilton on October 12, 2026: "Yesterday wasn’t the result we were looking for, and that’s on me. At a track that’s difficult to overtake you need to try something different, and I chose a strategy that ultimately didn’t deliver. It’s a painful lesson to learn, but I take full responsibility for the decisions I made. In this sport, not every call will work out. It’s about accepting when you get it wrong and how you move forward.

I’m grateful to the team for the work they put in every weekend. P6 doesn’t reflect the pace we had in the car, and despite the result there are positives to take away. Massive thanks to the fans in Singapore for the energy. I’ll continue to put the work in and come back fighting at the next race 🇸🇬✌🏾".

posts.meta_description: 738K likes, 1,423 comments - lewishamilton on October 8, 2026: "SINGAPORE 🇸🇬 Thanks so much for all the love so far. I hope everyone’s enjoying the @plus44world pop up and the Orbit 44 gallery exhibition. I’ve always admired @jahan_’s art, so collaborating with him on this collection is super exciting. I’m grateful for the opportunity to see his work in person. The scale and the detail in his work, the time that goes into hand painting and hand sculpting, it’s incredible. If you’ve not been yet, make sure you stop by @marinabaysands to check them both out ~".

posts.meta_description:
2M likes, 9,606 comments - lewishamilton on September 28, 2026: "It’s been one year since Roscoe’s passing. Being without my best friend has been hard, and there’s not a day that goes by that I don’t wish he was with me. I think of him and Coco every day, and as sad as I am to not have them, I’m so grateful for the time I shared with them and to have had them in my life. They’ve been there for some of the happiest times of my life. Today, I’m looking through these photos and videos laughing and smiling so big remembering those moments 

So many of you have been through this and reached out with love and support. It means so much to me, knowing how much Roscoe was loved. Rest’s in peace buddy’s, love you always.".
